# Shanaya Mahendran — Personal Web Portfolio

> Shanaya Mahendran is a Full-Stack Developer, Tech Enthusiast, and Open-Source Contributor. She builds modern, high-performance web applications using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python (FastAPI), Prisma ORM, Supabase, and PostgreSQL.

## Key Information Overview
- **Role**: Full-Stack Developer & Tech Enthusiast
- **Education**: 
  - BSc in Information Technology at University of Moratuwa (GPA: 3.76)
  - BSc in Computer Science at University of the People (CGPA: 3.96)
- **Primary Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Express, Prisma ORM, Supabase, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Docker, Tailwind CSS.
- **Featured Projects**:
  - Smart School Management System (SSMS): Enterprise-grade multi-role school management system (Admin, Teacher, Student, Parent) built with Next.js 14, Prisma, Supabase PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, and client-side PDF document generation.
  - Sara: Full-stack e-commerce platform built with FastAPI + PostgreSQL, Docker, FAISS vector search, WebSockets, and Vite frontend.
  - CabXpert: Vehicle reservation system using Java EE (Jersey JAX-RS), MySQL, JDBC, and Bootstrap.
  - Elegant Notes: Offline-first PWA with Supabase real-time sync and Tiptap rich editor.
  - PTET Web: Open-source contribution (43 merged PRs) building backend APIs and full-stack features.
- **Programmes & Leadership**:
  - IEEE Computer Society R10 Summer School 2026 (Participant, University of Moratuwa)
  - OMLAS Champion 2026 (One Million Leaders Asia)
  - National Entrepreneurship Development Programme (NEDP Phase 3)
- **Achievements**: First Place Gold Medalist – 1st Alliance Cup Full Contact Karate 2025 (UWMF-Japan)
